extDescription.message: Preview CSV and TSV attachments on a Jira issue in a table viewer, without downloading them.

commandOpenPanel.message: Open CSV attachments for this issue

viewAttachments.message: View the CSV/TSV attachments in this issue

viewerTimeoutDetail.message: The viewer page took too long to load. Try again or download the file.

permissionErrorDetail.message: Chrome blocked the download because the attachment is served from another domain. You can grant that permission in the extension settings. Details: $1

sessionExpired.message: The Jira session expired. Reload the page and sign in again.

fileTooLargeWithSize.message: The file is $1. The viewer limit is $2.

loginPageReturned.message: Jira returned a sign-in page. Reload the issue and sign in again.

headerTitle.message: Use the first row as the header

loadingDetail.message: This may take a few seconds for large files.

noRowsHeaderOnly.message: The file has headers but no data rows.

exportViewHint.message: Download a CSV with the current order and filter

analyzingDetail.message: Detecting the delimiter, encoding and columns.

headerOnTitle.message: The first row is used as the header

headerOffTitle.message: The first row is shown as data

resizerTitle.message: Drag to resize · double-click to fit

emptyHeaderOnly.message: The file only has a header row. Turn off “Header” to view it as data.

emptyNoRows.message: The file does not contain rows.

noRowsFound.message: No rows were found in the file.

analyzerLoadError.message: Could not load the CSV parser.

encodingUnsupported.message: The encoding $1 is not supported by this browser.

lastColumnVisible.message: At least one column must remain visible

optionsSubtitle.message: Preview CSV and TSV attachments without downloading them.

useFirstRowHeader.message: Use the first row as the header

headerHint.message: You can change it at any time in the viewer with the “Header” button.

readingNote.message: The viewer automatically detects the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab or pipe) and the encoding. You can also change them in the toolbar.

sitesIntro.message: The extension works with Jira Cloud by default. For Jira Data Center or a custom domain, add the base URL and grant access only to that site.

sitesReloadNote.message: After adding or removing a site, reload the Jira tabs you already have open.

downloadsIntro.message: Some Jira installations serve attachments from an external domain (for example, an S3 bucket). If the preview fails with a permission warning, enable this option.

allowAnyDomain.message: Allow downloading attachments from any domain

allowAnyDomainHint.message: Only used for the file you ask to preview. It is off by default and can be revoked here.

shortcutClose.message: Close the viewer or the open dialog

shortcutNote.message: You can change the shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

privacyIntro.message: The extension does not collect data, use analytics, or send anything outside your browser. It only queries the attachment list of the issue you are viewing and downloads the file you choose to preview, using your Jira session.

siteUrlProtocol.message: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

siteUrlCredentials.message: Do not include a username or password in the URL.

siteDuplicate.message: That site is already in the list.

sitePermissionRequestFailed.message: Chrome could not request permission for that site.

sitePermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so the site was not added.

siteEnableError.message: Could not enable the site. Check the extension permissions.

popupEmptyTitle.message: Open a Jira issue with a .csv or .tsv attachment.

popupEmptyHint.message: The CSV button will appear in the bottom-right corner of the issue.

openFromJiraDetail.message: Click the CSV button on an issue with .csv or .tsv attachments.
